opinion.originalText:
Sep 4, 2026: Sail with the Tide?
$SNDK $MU $PLTR $NVDA $HOOD $DELL $SNOW $CRCL $BE $LITE $CRWD $NTNX

First week into this "seasonally weak" September that now seems to be a public knowledge/ common sense thanks to the social media.

SPX is seen digesting above 8ema, while portfolio is closing green thanks to the breakout in my long term hold memory names ($SNDK $MU).

A) AI revolution is the TIDE. 

In the personal context of an investor operating a longer timeframe, I care less about technical precision but care more if I am positioned well (overall exposure, names) in this AI revolution.  The rest are smaller waves which cause you nausea if you are navigating with your small boat.

You can't stop this bubble, I mean, revolution. 
Time is your friend.

B) Portfolio (12 names).

Some shift in weights: 
1. $MU and $SNDK still the core. Tiny trims after close just to reward myself.
2. Holding $NVDA for the ultimate multiple expansions.
3. Trimming some $PLTR as the SoF for new purchases.
4. A beautiful top up below $120 onto $HOOD.
5. Trimming some $DELL and $SNOW after their great earnings reaction but seems short term tired.
6. $CRCL is a new entry below $100 for a stable coin play. 
7. $BE new entry, and looks great with the after hours announcement of entering S&P500.
8. $LITE volatile but nothing wrong, still trusting my stop at the last price structure HL
9. $CRWD and $NTNX are new buys with no traction yet, waiting to prove themselves (or out)
10. Note I massage my portfolio frequently and change the weights/ names regularly according to how I personally see the market and my portfolio as a whole.

And remember each trader is different.

What works for you doesn't work for me, vice versa.

C) Be Calm & Patience. Know yourself.

How the heck are you going to trade/ invest if not?

HAGW.
